name: Carl-OS Evaluation Protocol
description: This protocol defines the evaluation criteria for the Carl-OS reference implementation: five simulation scale experiment groups covering event-driven efficiency, swarm tolerance under dropout and adversarial conditions, scale behavior, governance invariants, and layer modularity. Each experiment states a reference claim and a falisfier; exploratory conditions carry no directional claim. Criteria were fixed in code before the experiments were executed. Locked Round-2 criteria for robust aggregation and scale extensions are included for future work.
